introLede: A curated list of comfortable options in Lagos (arrival city) and Umuahia (wedding location) for guests travelling from abroad.

regions.title: For guests arriving into Lagos before travelling onward
regions.lede: Short listings focused on airport access, transit comfort, and a smooth first night in Nigeria.

hotels.name: Shoregate Hotels
hotels.description: Ikeja GRA property with a rooftop terrace, pool, and 24-hour restaurant (African and continental). A strong pick for a comfortable first night after you land.
hotels.location: 29 Joel Ogunnaike St, Ikeja GRA, Ikeja
hotels.distance: ~15–30 mins to Murtala Muhammed International (traffic dependent)
hotels.bestFor: Airport access & settling in after a long flight

guestIntel.title: Before you arrive
guestIntel.body: Reach out to the hotel to arrange airport pickup or a trusted airport transfer, and share your ETA—Lagos traffic makes timing worth double-checking.

hotels.name: Lagos Marriott Hotel Ikeja
hotels.description: Full-service Marriott in Ikeja GRA with several restaurants and bars, an outdoor pool, fitness centre, and spa—polished comfort for a first night after landing.
hotels.location: 122 Joel Ogunnaike St, Ikeja GRA, Ikeja
hotels.distance: ~15–30 mins to Murtala Muhammed International (traffic dependent)
hotels.bestFor: Premium GRA stay with on-site dining & spa

guestIntel.title: Good to know
guestIntel.body: Same Joel Ogunnaike street as Shoregate—easy to compare if you’re weighing both.

regions.title: For the ceremony and local events
regions.lede: Stays centred on convenience, security, and proximity to weekend gatherings. We’ll keep refreshing this list as details are confirmed.

hotels.name: Hotel Royal Damgrete
hotels.description: Upscale GRA hotel with spacious rooms, strong security, and poolside dining—a well-established choice for wedding guests.
hotels.bestFor: Wedding guests, families & comfortable extended stays

guestIntel.title: Location tip
guestIntel.body: Situated inside the GRA area, which is generally quieter and more secure than busier parts of town.

guestIntel.title: Airport transfer
guestIntel.body: We recommend arranging pickup in advance if arriving from Owerri airport, especially for evening arrivals.

hotels.name: Garden City Placeholder Lodge
hotels.description: Quieter property with greener grounds—still a short hop to town.

guestIntel.title: Guest perk
guestIntel.body: Placeholder code UMUAHIA-JJ for a welcome basket—swap for real details when confirmed.

pageTip.title: If you're flying internationally, stay one night in Lagos first
pageTip.body: It gives you breathing room for connections, luggage, and rest before the journey to Umuahia—especially after a long-haul flight.
